supersedes.note: The 2026-07-19 artifact keeps its own hash and remains the authority for the required Codex devcontainer non-interactive row.

probe.model_input_capture: loopback ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL recorder with a dummy ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; request bodies only, headers never stored

authentication.note: Authentication is a precondition, never delivery evidence. Account identifiers are intentionally omitted.

claude-hook-additional-context.byte_limit_rationale: UTF-8 byte count is never below the character or UTF-16 unit count, so a payload of at most 10000 bytes stays inside the observed 10000-character boundary under any counting basis.
claude-hook-additional-context.over_limit_behavior: the client replaces the value with a <persisted-output> preview plus a temporary-file pointer, which the delivery contract never accepts as delivery

claude-cli-append-system-prompt.mechanism: --append-system-prompt supplied by the canonical wrapper immediately before client invocation
claude-cli-append-system-prompt.hard_boundary: a single argument at or above the operating system MAX_ARG_STRLEN (131072 bytes here) never reaches the client: execve fails with E2BIG

claude-cli-stdin-prompt.mechanism: the serialized envelope is written to the client's stdin prompt in print mode

native_load_inspection.description: An out-of-band evidence run with identical client, project, settings, and channel configuration points ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at a loopback recorder and compares the captured model input against the manifest sources.
native_load_inspection.project_memory_delivery: the exact CLAUDE.md bytes, including the trailing newline, appear in the first user message under a '# claudeMd' heading labelled with the file's absolute path

rejected_mechanisms.claude -p -d api,hooks --debug-file: logs [API REQUEST] lines only; the model-input body is never written
rejected_mechanisms.model self-report: explicitly not evidence under the native-load evidence contract

native_load_inspection.limitation: The capture run replaces the API endpoint, so it cannot run inside the canonical delivery launch itself; it is a separate identically configured run whose evidence any client, settings, trust, or channel change invalidates.

trust.non_interactive: the trust dialog is skipped; project .claude/settings.json hooks executed with no trust record present, and invalid settings files are silently ignored
trust.interactive: an untrusted project blocks at the trust dialog before any model-input request is constructed; a further one-time onboarding dialog can also block startup
trust.consequence: the launcher must prove the trusted, hook-active state itself and must validate its own settings file; the client's own silence is never proof

lifecycle.start: the requested session identity is honored in both print and interactive mode and is reported as session_id in --output-format json
lifecycle.clear: a fresh invocation without --session-id or --resume creates a new identity
lifecycle.fork: --fork-session creates a new identity from a resumed session
lifecycle.compaction: unverified: PreCompact and PostCompact exist in the executable but no compaction transition was captured, so a launcher must fail closed rather than infer generation preservation

rows.notes: Primary canonical channel. It carries the current 7160-byte fa-auth-m8 envelope with headroom, and any larger envelope must fall through to the full-content row.
Full-content fallback for an envelope above the hook boundary, up to the workspace policy hard limit. Its single-argument ceiling is an operating-system limit, not a client limit.

Available headroom beyond the argument-vector ceiling; it places the envelope in the user turn rather than the system prompt and has no interactive counterpart, so it is not part of the minimum viable set.

Byte-exact parity with the non-interactive hook row, including the same 10001-character rejection. Canonical use additionally requires settled trust and onboarding dialogs and generation state, because UserPromptSubmit fires on every prompt.
One startup injection per interactive launch, which matches exactly-once semantics per launcher-controlled generation.
Unavailable to this probe. No behavior is inferred from the devcontainer rows.

invalidation: any Claude executable, version, or SHA-256 change, including an automatic update
any change to user, project, or launcher settings, hook registration, or trust state
any change to the selected channel, its limit, or the reserved margin
any change to the native-load inspection mechanism or its evidence run
any devcontainer bootstrap-lock or platform change

measurement.consequence: The hook row's 10000-byte ceiling is a total, not an envelope allowance: with the measured 3037-byte native Claude bootstrap only 6963 bytes remain, and the current 7160-byte fa-auth-m8 envelope exceeds that by 197 bytes. Canonical fa-auth-m8 delivery therefore selects the full-content row, and Step 12.4 must select by model_visible_total rather than envelope size alone.
